messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — want to prioritize operator dashboard and tracing hooks for Q2 launch. Customers flagged cost visibility + error drilldown as blockers.
Kevin (Eng): Do we mean a single-pane operator view with cost per-route, token-cost waterfall, and tail-latency? Need to be explicit so infra can estimate.
Andre (SRE): +1 on single pane. For tracing hooks we need per-tenant sampling knobs and a low-overhead mode for hot paths. Also concerned about trace storage cost if we sample too much.
Sara (Design): I can do a compact operator layout that surfaces cost + error hotspots with drilldown flyouts. Will prioritize mobile-like density for busy ops screens.
Tom (CS): Heads-up: Customer A will only sign off on GA if they can slice cost by project tag and see 30d trends. Customer B asked specifically for slow-query -> trace link.
Maya (PM): Proposed MVP scope: tiles = cost-by-project (7d/30d), token-cost waterfall (top 10 routes), error-rate by service with top error types, trace-sample viewer (click -> raw trace). Launch criteria: cost tile accuracy within 15% vs billing, UI trace open <200ms, ability to toggle sampling policy per-tenant.
Kevin (Eng): Implementation risks: token-cost waterfall needs a new aggregation pipeline (token attribution across routes). Rough ETA: 4 sprints if we do full rollup, 2 sprints if we allow single-region only.
Andre (SRE): Can we define fallback UX for query timeouts? If backend aggregation fails, show precomputed aggregates + a warning. That keeps the UI responsive and avoids SLO breaches.
Maya (PM): Agreed. Fallback = aggregated numbers + "refreshing" hint. That preserves operator UX without blocking launch.
Sara (Design): Draft mocks: https://figma.com/proto/operator-cost-mock (placeholder). I'll attach variant with compact and expanded drilldown.
Kevin (Eng): For trace hooks, here's a tiny config proposal to discuss with infra:
```
sampling:
  strategy: dynamic
  threshold_ms: 120
  per_tenant: true
  fallback: aggregate_only
```
This lets us route only traces above threshold and adjust per-tenant.
Tom (CS): +1 on per-tenant. Customers will tune threshold based on their error budget. Also request: ability to pin a route to always-sample for debugging.
Andre (SRE): We should also add rollout guard: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated SLO checks at each step. If token-cost estimation error > 20% or trace pipeline lag > 30s, rollback.
Maya (PM): Decision: cut high-cardinality tag breakdown (e.g., user_id-level) from MVP. Keep project-tag and route-level breakdowns. This reduces pipeline complexity and cost.
Kevin (Eng): Agree — that reduces cardinality and speeds up the aggregator.
Andre (SRE): Agree. Also I'll draft the SLO checks and canary automation by EOD Tuesday.
Maya (PM): Action items: Kevin -> build aggregation proto + rough sizing estimate (due Fri), Andre -> define sampling API + canary SLO hooks (EOD Tue), Sara -> final mocks (EOD Wed), Tom -> confirm Customer A tagging acceptance and Customer B trace link requirement (Thu).
Maya (PM): Reconvene Thurs 10am. If anyone sees a hard blocker before then, ping here. :calendar: :eyes:
Kevin (Eng): Quick q: do we want to provide a "cost explainer" tooltip that breaks token-cost into model + infra + infra-accelerator?
Tom (CS): Yes, Customer A asked for that. Keep it high-level.
Sara (Design): I'll add a small tooltip pattern and a microcopy draft.
release-bot: Scheduled a quick experiment namespace creation for canary tests (ns=obs-mvp-canary, id=exp-781).
Andre (SRE): Noted. I'll wire up monitoring hooks to exp-781 and set alerts.
Maya (PM): Thanks team — thumbs if you agree with scope and action items.
Kevin (Eng): :+1:
Andre (SRE): :thumbsup:
Sara (Design): :+1:
Tom (CS): :+1:
Maya (PM): Closing thread — see you Thur 10am.
